_meta.description: Taxonomy for auto-categorizing invention ideas. Used by the LLM to assign a Category property to new ideas in the INVENT database.
_meta.instructions: Match the idea against the keywords list. If multiple categories match, pick the primary one. If truly hybrid, use 'Combination / System'.

categories.name: Hardware / Physical Product
categories.description: Tangible devices, gadgets, tools, materials, or physical inventions

categories.name: Software / App
categories.description: Mobile apps, web applications, desktop software, algorithms

categories.name: Service / Platform
categories.description: Service businesses, marketplaces, platforms connecting people

categories.name: Process / Method
categories.description: New methods, workflows, techniques, or processes

categories.name: Content / Media
categories.description: Content formats, media products, educational materials, entertainment

categories.name: Biotech / Health
categories.description: Health, medical, biotech, wellness, or nutrition inventions

categories.name: Combination / System
categories.description: Multi-component systems that span hardware + software + service
